You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

from collections import deque
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    seen=set(); cs=[]
    for p in [(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)]:
        if not g[p[0]][p[1]] or p in seen: continue
        q=[p]; comp=[]; seen.add(p)
        while q:
            r,c=q.pop(); comp.append(p)
            for dr in(-1,0,1):
                for dc in(-1,0,1):
                    n=((r+dr),(c+dc))
                    if 0<=n[0]<H and 0<=n[1]<W and g[n[0]][n[1]] and n not in seen:
                        seen.add(n); q.append(n)
        cs.append(comp)
    main=max(cs,key=len)
    pat={(p[0]-min(q[0] for q in main),p[1]-min(q[1] for q in main),g[p[0]][p[1]]) for p in main}
    iso=[p for comp in cs if comp is not main for p in comp]
    # choose target iso5 that fits fully inside grid
    sm=[p for p in main if g[p[0]][p[1]]==5][0]
    mr=(sm[0]-min(q[0] for q in main), sm[1]-min(q[1] for q in main))
    fm=[f for f in iso if 0<=f[0]-mr[0]+pat_rows(f,pat)<=H-1 and 0<=f[1]-mr[1]+pat_wid(pat,pat)<=W-1]
    fm=fm[0]
    tl=(fm[0]-mr[0], fm[1]-mr[1])
    for pr,pc in main: out[pr][pc]=0
    out[fm[0]][fm[1]]=0
    for dr,dc,v in pat: out[tl[0]+dr][tl[1]+dc]=v
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))

def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cs=comps_of(g)
    main=max(cs,key=len)
    five=[p for p in main if g[p[0]][p[1]]==5][0]
    br=min(p[0] for p in main); bc=min(p[1] for p in main)
    mr=(five[0]-br,five[1]-bc)
    pat=[(pr-br,pc-bc,g[pr][pc]) for pr,pc in main if g[pr][pc]!=5]
    for comp in cs:
        if comp is main: continue
        fives_in=[p for p in comp if g[p[0]][p[1]]==5]
        if not fives_in: continue
        fm=fives_in[0]
        tl=(fm[0]-mr[0],fm[1]-mr[1])
        for dr,dc,v in pat:
            rr,cc=tl[0]+dr,tl[1]+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=v
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])

import json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cs=comps_of(g)
    main=max(cs,key=len)

import json
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[row[:] for row in g]
    cs=comps_of(g)
    main=max(cs,key=len)
    five=[p for p in main if g[p[0]][p[1]]==5][0]
    br=min(p[0] for p in main); bc=min(p[1] for p in main)
    mr=(five[0]-br,five[1]-bc)
    pat=[(pr-br,pc-bc,g[pr][pc]) for pr,pc in main if g[pr][pc]!=5]
    for comp in cs:
        if comp is main: continue
        fives_in=[p for p in comp if g[p[0]][p[1]]==5]
        if not fives_in: continue
        fm=fives_in[0]
        tl=(fm[0]-mr[0],fm[1]-mr[1])
        for dr,dc,v in pat:
            rr,cc=tl[0]+dr,tl[1]+dc
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: out[rr][cc]=v
        out[fm[0]][fm[1]]=0
    return out
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    print(k, solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output'])
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
